name: Sergra Darkthorn
summary: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn awaits tauren hunters leaving Mulgore behind. Melor Stonehoof sends them north into the Barrens, where danger grows harsher and the Horde's lands reach beyond their home.

sections.title: Leaving the Sacred Hills
sections.body: When their first trials are done, Melor Stonehoof sends young tauren hunters east from Mulgore. Bloodhoof Village and its valleys are familiar ground, where patient tracking has prepared them for what comes next. Now he tells them to pack their gear and cross the mountain pass into the Barrens, leaving their homeland's safety for harsher country.

sections.title: The Road to the Crossroads
sections.body:
The road winds through red rock canyons before opening onto the Barrens' broad, sun-scorched savanna. There, where Kalimdor's central trade routes meet, the Crossroads is a fortified settlement shared by orcs, trolls, and tauren.

Sergra Darkthorn waits on its eastern side. The experienced orc shaman demands much of the hunters she guides. She teaches those who come to stalk the Barrens' fierce wildlife, testing their eagerness against the discipline the wilderness requires.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof gives the task to tauren hunters. You can find the hunter mentor on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.
Sergra Darkthorn waits at the Crossroads in the central Barrens, near its eastern side, watchtowers, and corrals.

faq.q: How do I get to the Crossroads from Mulgore?
aliases: how to get to crossroads from thunder bluff
faq.answer: From Thunder Bluff, travel south past Bloodhoof Village, then take the eastern road through the canyon pass into the Barrens. After the border gate, follow the main dirt road east to its fork, then head north to the Crossroads.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The journey guides hunters from Mulgore to the Crossroads, a major center in the Barrens, where local hunting work awaits.

faq.q: Do orcs and trolls get this quest?
faq.answer: Orcs and trolls receive a similar task called Conscript of the Horde in Durotar. It sends them from Razor Hill to the Barrens, where they can also meet Sergra and take work from her.

faq.q: What does Sergra Darkthorn teach hunters?
faq.answer: Sergra tests incoming hunters against Barrens wildlife, beginning with plainstriders and prowlers. She teaches endurance, respect for the land, and mental resilience over brute force.

angles.text: As a tauren raised in Mulgore, reporting to Sergra takes you beyond your ancestral homeland and into the wider Horde's service.
As a hunter, you leave simple tracking of local game behind and face the predators and harsh conditions of Kalimdor's inner savannas.
At the Crossroads, you find a center of Horde logistics where orcish resilience, Darkspear cunning, and tauren tradition meet under veterans such as Sergra.
